The '''Avatar-10''' was a Class 2.0 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] unit manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]<ref name="GG6-2" /> several decades before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The "stock" [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] was equipped with an Avatar-10 hyperdrive as standard.<ref name="HaynesManual">''[[Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual]]''</ref> The drive weighed 15 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].<ref name="GG6-2" />

An innovative development in hyperdrive technology, the Avatar-10 was designed to be a "universal" hyperdrive system that was compatible with any type of spacecraft.<ref name="GG6-2" /> Although critics noted that the bulky hyperdrive was too large for vessels that, by design, were too small to accommodate its weight even with industrial [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], the Avatar-10 became a popular choice for upgrading older [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]].<ref name="HaynesManual" />

Because the Avatar-10 was developed before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], its fast Class 2.0 speed, normally restricted to military vessels, remained legal. Modifying the drive for faster speeds was a strict violation of Imperial law, however. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was originally equipped with an Avatar-10, though it had been replaced by an illegally-upgraded [[Isu-Sim/Legends|Isu-Sim]] [[SSP05 hyperdrive generator/Legends|SSP05 hyperdrive generator]] long before it came into the ownership of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="HaynesManual" /> In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Fenig Nabon]] ordered an Avatar-10 as a replacement for the ''[[Star Lady]]''{{'s}} damaged drive on [[Prishardia]].<ref name="ST">{{StoryCite|story=Simple Tricks|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref>
